questions.stem: This high-resolution coronary CT angiogram is annotated with a white arrow pointing to the left anterior descending artery. What does the arrow indicate?

choices.label: A
choices.text: A myocardial bridge over a normal vessel

choices.label: D
choices.text: A saccular aneurysm of the vessel

explanation.summary: Coronary CT angiography is a sensitive noninvasive test for coronary artery occlusion. The arrow marks a focal narrowing (stenosis) of the LAD lumen; a positive scan is typically confirmed with functional testing or invasive angiography before intervention.
explanation.whyCorrect: Coronary CT angiography is a sensitive noninvasive test for coronary artery occlusion. The arrow marks a focal narrowing (stenosis) of the LAD lumen; a positive scan is typically confirmed with functional testing or invasive angiography before intervention.
